​Environment & Lighting Integration:

Overhead, sweeping cel-shaded ribbons of emerald-green and violet aurora borealis shimmer across a starry illustrated night sky. True-to-life, multicolored emerald and violet light from the anime aurora wraps naturally around the real-life cosplayer’s face, crimson hair drills, tactical armor, and boots, seamlessly unifying the photographic subject with the vibrant 2D anime world.
